newsitem.title: CHINA: China confirms N.Korea defector has left.
newsitem.headline: China confirms N.Korea defector has left.

text.p: China confirmed on Tuesday that North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop had left for a third country, the Xinhua news agency said.
Hwang had left of his own free will, it said.

"China, proceeding from safeguarding the peace and stability on the Korean peninsula, according to Hwang's own will and considering the positions taken by the parties concerned, has sent Hwang out of China's territory for a third country," Xinhua said.
It said the departure was in accordance with international law and practice.
The report did not identify the third country, but officials in the Philippines said Hwang had been taken to safety in the northern mountain resort of Baguio.
